signature: SUBROUTINE DTPTTF( TRANSR, UPLO, N, AP, ARF, INFO )

params.name: transr
params.reference:
-   `= 'N'`: `ARF` in Normal format is wanted;
-   `= 'T'`: `ARF` in Conjugate-transpose format is wanted.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: A is upper triangular;
-   `= 'L'`: A is lower triangular.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: AP
params.reference: On entry, the upper or lower triangular matrix A, packed columnwise in a linear array. The j-th column of A is stored in the array `AP` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*j/2) = A(i,j)` for $1 \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AP(i + (j-1)*(2n-j)/2) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le n$.

params.name: ARF
params.reference: On exit, the upper or lower triangular matrix A stored in RFP format. For a further discussion see Notes below.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
